reason: I have one or two chairs and I count the drawer myself every night, so I already know what came in. My bookings and customers are all on WhatsApp and it works; ₹999 every month plus ₹4,999 upfront is a lot from what I earn for something I mostly do with my own eyes.
objection: My boys are busy cutting hair, they will not stop to take a selfie and type every walk-in's number and bill in an English app. In two weeks nobody will use it and I will still be paying.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked inside WhatsApp itself with no typing for the staff, and cost a few hundred rupees a month with no setup fee.
